import json, pathlib, subprocess, shutil
svc='jellyfin-pink.service'
services=(svc,'vivoapk-backend.service','nginx.service','postgresql.service')
def run(args,timeout=20):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()
def prop(k): return run(['systemctl','show',svc,'-p',k,'--value'])[1]
def health(): return {s:run(['systemctl','is-active',s])[1] for s in services}
before=health()
pid=int(prop('MainPID') or '0')
assert pid>0 and prop('User')=='jellyfinpink' and all(v=='active' for v in before.values())
# Run only this read-only bounded inspection with the existing sudo authorization.
# Do not print process arguments, environment, raw maps, secrets or database data.
script="""import sys,pathlib,os,hashlib,json,stat,re,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server').resolve()
source=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/Vivoapk/source')
pid=int(sys.argv[1])
proc=pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(pid)
exe=(proc/'exe').resolve(strict=True)
names=('Jellyfin.Api.dll','Jellyfin.LiveTv.dll','Jellyfin.Plugin.VivoapkMegaAuth.dll')
allowed=(root,pathlib.Path('/usr/lib/jellyfin'),pathlib.Path('/usr/share/jellyfin'))
def safe(p): return any(p.is_relative_to(a) for a in allowed)
mapped={n:set() for n in names}
for line in (proc/'maps').read_text().splitlines():
 fields=line.split(None,5)
 if len(fields)!=6: continue
 path=pathlib.Path(fields[5])
 if path.name in names and path.is_absolute() and safe(path):
  mapped[path.name].add(path)
paths=[exe.parent,root/'app',root/'bin',root/'server',pathlib.Path('/usr/lib/jellyfin/bin'),pathlib.Path('/usr/lib/jellyfin')]
plugin=root/'data/plugins/VivoAPK Mega OTT Auth_0.1.0.0'/names[2]
result={}
for n in names:
 candidates=set(mapped[n])
 if n==names[2]: candidates.add(plugin)
 else: candidates.update(p/n for p in paths)
 records=[]
 for p in sorted(candidates):
  if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink() or not safe(p.resolve()): continue
  st=p.stat()
  records.append({'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':st.st_size,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)),'mapped':p in mapped[n]})
 result[n]=records
r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(source),'-C',str(source),'rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
sha=r.stdout.strip()
result['backend_sha']=sha if r.returncode==0 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',sha) else None
result['private_network_namespace']=(proc/'ns/net').stat().st_ino!=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/ns/net').stat().st_ino
result['runtime_executable_in_allowed_tree']=safe(exe)
result['component_identity_complete']=all(len(result[n])==1 for n in names) and all(any(x['mapped'] for x in result[n]) for n in names)
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
"""
rc,out=run(['sudo','-n','--','/usr/bin/python3','-c',script,str(pid)],35)
assert rc==0 and out, 'read-only privileged component inspection failed'
identity=json.loads(out)
result={'scope':'read-only production component identity and backend revision; no install, no network or service changes','identity':identity,'same_main_pid':int(prop('MainPID') or '0')==pid,'services_before':before,'services_after':health(),'disk_free_bytes':shutil.disk_usage('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server').free}
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
assert result['same_main_pid'] and result['services_after']==before
assert identity['backend_sha']=='74b6a02be199a29c305058d2875063eb46c1b61d', 'backend revision requires review'
assert identity['component_identity_complete'], 'loaded component identity incomplete'
